To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we construct an open-closed string theory on the RP 2 world sheet geometry.
we present the construction of open-close string field theory based upon RP2 geometry, and that it provides an interpolation of D-branes and orientifold planes of all possible dimensions.
we have constructed a background independent open/closed string field theory on a disc and an RP 2 geometry and found an interpolation of orientifolds of various dimensions and of D-branes.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following three subjects: (i) construction of the BRS operator in boundary string field theory, (ii) off-shell extension of boundary/crosscap string states and (iii) construction of boundary string field theories on RP 2 world-sheet geometries.
the extension of the boundary string field theory to the case of RP 2 geometrical world-sheet, which is a generalization of the Witten’s boundary string field theory.
the following two points: (i) We extend the boundary string field theory of Witten to the case of disc and RP 3 geometries.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the boundary string field theory is extended to a theory which describes the coupling of the open string sector to the closed string sector in a unified manner.
our construction of the off-shell boundary string field theory is a natural and consistent generalization of Witten's construction.
the open-closed string theory is a theory of boundary/crosscap strings.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the open-closed string theory on the disc and the RP 2 geometrics is equivalent to the open-closed superstring theory with orientifold planes and D-branes.
we have a string field theory which describes the dynamics of the boundary states of various dimensions, the crosscap state, and the open/closed string interactions.

the open-closed string theory on the disc and RP 0,2,4 geometries provides a unified description of the open string theories on the D-branes and orientifold planes, and their closed string backgrounds.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the open-closed string interaction vertex is given as a sum of two terms, one of which is a product of the disc interaction vertex and a closed string propagator.
the open-closed string coupling is determined by the boundary state in the closed string channel, while the open string channel is described by the boundary string field theory.
the boundary string field theory is a powerful tool to describe open-closed strings on nontrivial worldsheet geometries and to construct off-shell extension of D-branes and orientifolds.
